## Checklist

- [ ] Discussed in an issue first (the merge-or-stand-alone conversation belongs there, not in a diff)
- [ ] Considered merging into an existing entry — and said why it stands alone if it does
- [ ] Name is six words or fewer, actor plus action, not mechanism
- [ ] Passes the retell test — a non-expert could repeat it after hearing it once
- [ ] Passes the sorting test — one person and one moment (persona), or a chronic drift (condition)
- [ ] States the AI delta where it is not self-evident
- [ ] Adopted an existing industry term where one exists; coined only where none does
- [ ] Full entries fill every section of `framework/entry-template.md`
- [ ] Includes an honest caveat naming what the entry oversimplifies
- [ ] Credit recorded in the entry and in `CONTRIBUTORS.md`
- [ ] No identifying details of private sources in tracked files
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if this changes an axis, merges entries, or alters a control
